scientific_integrity: The theorem concerns a trajectory-level Bloch-phase signal reconstructed from reset histories; it is not a standard invasive sequential quantum measurement correlator. The infinite-time assertion is proved from an explicit renewal decomposition and Abel cancellation, not inferred from finite numerical checks.
scientific_limitations: Exact Sibuya hazard with \(0<\gamma<1\) and nontrivial fixed unitary phase
Complete reset to a fixed pure qubit state; no claim for partial or invasive measurement resets
No uniform finite-time or near-resonance estimate
Classical arcsine persistence is prior knowledge; broader unindexed results and an inaccessible detailed 2026 source remain possible priority risks
title: Aging two-time phase memory in Sibuya-reset qubits
